structure.unit: Food and Drink; Weights and Measures

law.catch_line: Daily cleaning of instruments and machinery
law.text: All trucks, trays, boxes, baskets, buckets, and other receptacles, chutes, platforms, racks, tables, shelves, and all knives, saws, cleavers, and other utensils and machinery used in moving, handling, cutting, chopping, mixing, canning, and any other process, shall be thoroughly cleaned daily.
